g.text: Characteristics of employed people by AI exposure · Korea, 2025
Fixed 2025 exposure quintiles. Survey-weighted April/October employment averages; percentages are group composition.
Education uses the retained attainment proxy, not graduate outcomes. Pay covers positive-paid wage employees only.
Age and hours differences are in years/hours; composition differences are percentage points. Counts are not unique longitudinal people.
